+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static marketing site for The Daily Grind Coffee Co., served with `pnpm start`.
+
+## Pages
+
+- `index.html` – home page.
+- `account/` – **My Account**, including passkey management (view, rename,
+  delete, create) for signed-in customers.
+
+## Passkey management
+
+`account/passkeys.js` renders the passkey list and keeps the browser's
+password manager in step with the account using the WebAuthn Signal API:
+
+- `signalAllAcceptedCredentials()` runs on page load and after every delete, so
+  a removed passkey also disappears from the user's authenticator.
+- `signalCurrentUserDetails()` runs after the display name is changed.
+- `signalUnknownCredential()` runs if the server rejects a newly created
+  passkey.
+
+All Signal API calls are feature-detected and skipped on browsers without them.
+
+### Backend contract
+
+`account/api.js` documents the JSON endpoints the page calls
+(`/api/user`, `/api/credentials`, `/api/credential/:id`,
+`/api/passkeys/register/*`). Implement them server-side with a vetted WebAuthn
+library (for example SimpleWebAuthn) and the page will use them automatically.
+
+When those endpoints are missing, which is the case on this static build, the
+page falls back to `account/local-store.js`, an in-browser store that keeps the
+demo customer's passkeys in `localStorage`. It is a demo convenience and not a
+security boundary: it checks challenge, origin and ceremony type but does not
+verify attestation signatures.
+
+### Provider names and icons
+
+`account/aaguids.json` is a trimmed copy of the community
+[passkey-authenticator-aaguids](https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids)
+registry: names for every provider, icons only for common consumer ones.
+Regenerate it with:
+
+```sh
+node scripts/build-aaguids.mjs
+```

+/**
+ * HTTP client for the account / passkey endpoints.
+ *
+ * Every method resolves with parsed JSON or rejects with an ApiError carrying
+ * the HTTP status. The shape mirrors the backend contract expected by
+ * passkeys.js; local-store.js implements the same interface in the browser for
+ * the static demo build.
+ *
+ *   GET    /api/user                          -> { id, name, displayName, rpId? }
+ *   PUT    /api/user                          <- { name, displayName }
+ *   GET    /api/credentials                   -> StoredPasskeyCredential[]
+ *   PUT    /api/credential/:id                <- { name }
+ *   DELETE /api/credential/:id
+ *   POST   /api/passkeys/register/options     -> PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON
+ *   POST   /api/passkeys/register/verify      <- RegistrationResponseJSON
+ */
+
+export class ApiError extends Error {
+  constructor(message, { status = 0, contentType = '' } = {}) {
+    super(message);
+    this.name = 'ApiError';
+    this.status = status;
+    this.contentType = contentType;
+  }
+}
+
+async function request(url, { method = 'GET', body } = {}) {
+  let response;
+  try {
+    response = await fetch(url, {
+      method,
+      credentials: 'same-origin',
+      headers: {
+        Accept: 'application/json',
+        ...(body !== undefined && { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }),
+      },
+      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw new ApiError(`Network error calling ${method} ${url}: ${err.message}`);
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    let detail = '';
+    if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
+      detail = (await response.json().catch(() => ({})))?.error || '';
+    }
+    throw new ApiError(detail || `${method} ${url} failed with ${response.status}`, {
+      status: response.status,
+      contentType,
+    });
+  }
+  if (response.status === 204) return null;
+  if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
+    // A static host serving index.html for unknown routes, or a proxy error page.
+    throw new ApiError(`${method} ${url} returned ${contentType || "an unknown content type"} instead of JSON`, {
+      status: response.status,
+      contentType,
+    });
+  }
+  return response.json();
+}
+
+export function createRemoteApi(base = '') {
+  return {
+    kind: 'remote',
+    getUser: () => request(`${base}/api/user`),
+    updateUser: (fields) => request(`${base}/api/user`, { method: 'PUT', body: fields }),
+    listCredentials: () => request(`${base}/api/credentials`),
+    renameCredential: (id, name) =>
+      request(`${base}/api/credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PUT', body: { name } }),
+    deleteCredential: (id) =>
+      request(`${base}/api/credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }),
+    registrationOptions: () =>
+      request(`${base}/api/passkeys/register/options`, { method: 'POST', body: { promotion: false } }),
+    verifyRegistration: (registrationResponse) =>
+      request(`${base}/api/passkeys/register/verify`, { method: 'POST', body: registrationResponse }),
+  };
+}

+/**
+ * Browser-local stand-in for the passkey backend.
+ *
+ * The Daily Grind site is served as static files, so there is no server to
+ * store credentials. This module keeps the signed-in demo customer's profile
+ * and registered passkeys in localStorage and exposes the same interface as
+ * createRemoteApi() in api.js. passkeys.js falls back to it automatically when
+ * the real endpoints are absent.
+ *
+ * It performs the structural checks a server would (challenge, origin, type)
+ * but does NOT verify attestation signatures. It is a demo data store, not a
+ * security boundary. A production deployment must implement the endpoints in
+ * api.js with a vetted WebAuthn library such as SimpleWebAuthn.
+ */
+
+const STORAGE_KEY = 'daily-grind.account.v1';
+const ZERO_AAGUID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
+const RP_NAME = 'The Daily Grind';
+
+// ---------- encoding helpers ----------
+
+export function toBase64Url(bytes) {
+  let binary = '';
+  for (const b of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(b);
+  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
+}
+
+export function fromBase64Url(str) {
+  const padded = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/').padEnd(Math.ceil(str.length / 4) * 4, '=');
+  const binary = atob(padded);
+  return Uint8Array.from(binary, (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
+}
+
+function randomBase64Url(byteLength) {
+  return toBase64Url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(byteLength)));
+}
+
+function bytesToUuid(bytes) {
+  const hex = Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Pulls the fields we need out of raw authenticator data.
+ * Layout: rpIdHash(32) | flags(1) | signCount(4) | [aaguid(16) | credIdLen(2) | credId | pubKey]
+ */
+export function parseAuthenticatorData(authData) {
+  if (authData.length < 37) throw new Error('Authenticator data is too short.');
+  const flags = authData[32];
+  const view = new DataView(authData.buffer, authData.byteOffset, authData.byteLength);
+  const parsed = {
+    userPresent: Boolean(flags & 0x01),
+    userVerified: Boolean(flags & 0x04),
+    backupEligible: Boolean(flags & 0x08),
+    backedUp: Boolean(flags & 0x10),
+    attestedCredentialData: Boolean(flags & 0x40),
+    counter: view.getUint32(33, false),
+    aaguid: ZERO_AAGUID,
+  };
+  if (parsed.attestedCredentialData && authData.length >= 55) {
+    parsed.aaguid = bytesToUuid(authData.subarray(37, 53));
+  }
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+// ---------- AAGUID registry (trimmed copy, see scripts/build-aaguids.mjs) ----------
+
+let registryPromise;
+async function lookupProvider(aaguid) {
+  if (!aaguid || aaguid === ZERO_AAGUID) return null;
+  registryPromise ??= fetch(new URL('./aaguids.json', import.meta.url))
+    .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : {}))
+    .catch(() => ({}));
+  const registry = await registryPromise;
+  return registry[aaguid] || null;
+}
+
+// ---------- persistence ----------
+
+function load() {
+  try {
+    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+    if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
+  } catch {
+    /* corrupted or unavailable storage: start fresh */
+  }
+  return {
+    user: {
+      id: randomBase64Url(16),
+      name: 'jane.doe@example.com',
+      displayName: 'Jane Doe',
+    },
+    credentials: [],
+    pendingChallenge: null,
+  };
+}
+
+function save(state) {
+  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
+}
+
+class StoreError extends Error {
+  constructor(message, status = 400) {
+    super(message);
+    this.name = 'StoreError';
+    this.status = status;
+  }
+}
+
+const clone = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
+
+export function createLocalStore() {
+  const rpId = location.hostname;
+
+  return {
+    kind: 'local',
+
+    async getUser() {
+      const { user } = load();
+      return { ...user, rpId };
+    },
+
+    async updateUser({ name, displayName }) {
+      const state = load();
+      if (typeof name === 'string' && name.trim()) state.user.name = name.trim();
+      if (typeof displayName === 'string' && displayName.trim()) state.user.displayName = displayName.trim();
+      save(state);
+      return { ...state.user, rpId };
+    },
+
+    async listCredentials() {
+      return clone(load().credentials);
+    },
+
+    async renameCredential(id, name) {
+      const state = load();
+      const cred = state.credentials.find((c) => c.id === id);
+      if (!cred) throw new StoreError('Credential not found.', 404);
+      cred.name = String(name).trim();
+      save(state);
+      return clone(cred);
+    },
+
+    async deleteCredential(id) {
+      const state = load();
+      const before = state.credentials.length;
+      state.credentials = state.credentials.filter((c) => c.id !== id);
+      if (state.credentials.length === before) throw new StoreError('Credential not found.', 404);
+      save(state);
+      return { success: true };
+    },
+
+    async registrationOptions() {
+      const state = load();
+      state.pendingChallenge = randomBase64Url(32);
+      save(state);
+      return {
+        challenge: state.pendingChallenge,
+        rp: { id: rpId, name: RP_NAME },
+        user: {
+          id: state.user.id,
+          name: state.user.name,
+          displayName: state.user.displayName,
+        },
+        pubKeyCredParams: [
+          { type: 'public-key', alg: -7 },
+          { type: 'public-key', alg: -257 },
+        ],
+        excludeCredentials: state.credentials.map((c) => ({
+          type: 'public-key',
+          id: c.id,
+          transports: c.transports,
+        })),
+        // Management flow: no authenticatorAttachment so security keys work too.
+        authenticatorSelection: {
+          residentKey: 'required',
+          requireResidentKey: true,
+          userVerification: 'preferred',
+        },
+        attestation: 'none',
+        timeout: 120_000,
+      };
+    },
+
+    async verifyRegistration(registration) {
+      const state = load();
+      const expectedChallenge = state.pendingChallenge;
+      state.pendingChallenge = null;
+      save(state);
+
+      if (!registration || registration.type !== 'public-key' || !registration.id) {
+        throw new StoreError('Malformed registration response.');
+      }
+      if (!expectedChallenge) throw new StoreError('No registration in progress.');
+
+      let clientData;
+      try {
+        clientData = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(fromBase64Url(registration.response.clientDataJSON)));
+      } catch {
+        throw new StoreError('Unreadable client data.');
+      }
+      if (clientData.type !== 'webauthn.create') throw new StoreError('Unexpected ceremony type.');
+      if (clientData.challenge !== expectedChallenge) throw new StoreError('Challenge mismatch.');
+      if (clientData.origin !== location.origin) throw new StoreError('Origin mismatch.');
+      if (state.credentials.some((c) => c.id === registration.id)) {
+        throw new StoreError('This passkey is already registered.', 409);
+      }
+
+      let authInfo = { aaguid: ZERO_AAGUID, backupEligible: false, backedUp: false, counter: 0, userPresent: true };
+      if (registration.response.authenticatorData) {
+        authInfo = parseAuthenticatorData(fromBase64Url(registration.response.authenticatorData));
+        if (!authInfo.userPresent) throw new StoreError('User presence was not confirmed.');
+      }
+
+      const provider = await lookupProvider(authInfo.aaguid);
+      const providerName = provider?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider';
+
+      const credential = {
+        id: registration.id,
+        passkeyUserId: state.user.id,
+        credentialPublicKey: registration.response.publicKey || null,
+        credentialType: 'public-key',
+        credentialDeviceType: authInfo.backupEligible ? 'multiDevice' : 'singleDevice',
+        credentialBackedUp: authInfo.backedUp,
+        aaguid: authInfo.aaguid,
+        providerName,
+        providerIcon: provider?.icon_light,
+        name: providerName,
+        transports: registration.response.transports || [],
+        registeredAt: Date.now(),
+        lastUsedAt: undefined,
+        counter: authInfo.counter,
+      };
+
+      // Re-read in case another tab changed the list while we awaited the registry.
+      const fresh = load();
+      fresh.credentials.push(credential);
+      save(fresh);
+      return clone(credential);
+    },
+  };
+}

+/**
+ * Passkey management for the My Account page.
+ *
+ * - Lists the customer's registered passkeys with provider, added and
+ *   last-used dates.
+ * - Renames a passkey (server-side nickname only).
+ * - Deletes a passkey, then tells the browser's password manager which
+ *   credentials remain via PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials().
+ * - Updates the display name and syncs it via signalCurrentUserDetails().
+ * - Registers a new passkey when the browser supports one.
+ *
+ * Signal API calls are feature-detected: browsers without them (Firefox at the
+ * time of writing) simply skip the sync.
+ */
+
+import { createRemoteApi, ApiError } from './api.js';
+import { createLocalStore } from './local-store.js';
+
+// ---------- DOM handles ----------
+
+const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
+const els = {
+  heading: $('passkeys-heading'),
+  list: $('passkey-list'),
+  rowTemplate: $('passkey-row-template'),
+  empty: $('passkey-empty'),
+  unsupported: $('passkey-unsupported'),
+  status: $('passkey-status'),
+  createBtn: $('create-passkey'),
+  demoNote: $('demo-note'),
+  renameDialog: $('rename-dialog'),
+  renameForm: $('rename-form'),
+  renameInput: $('rename-input'),
+  renameError: $('rename-error'),
+  deleteDialog: $('delete-dialog'),
+  deleteName: $('delete-passkey-name'),
+  profileForm: $('profile-form'),
+  profileName: $('profile-name'),
+  profileDisplayName: $('profile-display-name'),
+  profileStatus: $('profile-status'),
+  welcomeName: $('welcome-name'),
+};
+
+// ---------- state ----------
+
+let api;
+let user; // { id (base64url), name, displayName, rpId }
+let credentials = [];
+let pendingCredentialId = null;
+
+const dateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium' });
+
+// ---------- backend selection ----------
+
+/**
+ * Prefer the real endpoints. If the host is a plain static server (a 404, 405
+ * or an HTML fallback page instead of JSON), use the in-browser store so the
+ * page still works. Genuine server failures (5xx, JSON error bodies, network
+ * errors) are surfaced, not masked.
+ */
+async function selectApi() {
+  const remote = createRemoteApi();
+  try {
+    const remoteUser = await remote.getUser();
+    return { api: remote, user: remoteUser };
+  } catch (err) {
+    const staticHost =
+      err instanceof ApiError &&
+      [200, 404, 405].includes(err.status) &&
+      !err.contentType.includes('application/json');
+    if (!staticHost) throw err;
+  }
+  const local = createLocalStore();
+  els.demoNote.hidden = false;
+  return { api: local, user: await local.getUser() };
+}
+
+// ---------- capability detection ----------
+
+async function ensureWebAuthnJsonSupport() {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) return false;
+  if (!PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON) {
+    try {
+      await import('https://unpkg.com/webauthn-polyfills@0.1.7/esm/index.js');
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.warn('WebAuthn JSON polyfill failed to load', err);
+    }
+  }
+  return typeof PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON === 'function';
+}
+
+async function platformPasskeysAvailable() {
+  if (!(await ensureWebAuthnJsonSupport())) return false;
+  try {
+    const caps = (await PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities?.()) || {};
+    if (typeof caps.passkeyPlatformAuthenticator === 'boolean') return caps.passkeyPlatformAuthenticator;
+    if (typeof caps.userVerifyingPlatformAuthenticator === 'boolean') return caps.userVerifyingPlatformAuthenticator;
+    return await PublicKeyCredential.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable();
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+// ---------- Signal API ----------
+
+async function syncAcceptedCredentials(list) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+      rpId: user.rpId,
+      userId: user.id,
+      allAcceptedCredentialIds: list.map((c) => c.id),
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error('signalAllAcceptedCredentials failed', err);
+  }
+}
+
+async function syncUserDetails() {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalCurrentUserDetails) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails({
+      rpId: user.rpId,
+      userId: user.id,
+      name: user.name,
+      displayName: user.displayName,
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error('signalCurrentUserDetails failed', err);
+  }
+}
+
+async function signalUnknownCredential(credentialId) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalUnknownCredential) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId: user.rpId, credentialId });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error('signalUnknownCredential failed', err);
+  }
+}
+
+// ---------- rendering ----------
+
+function setStatus(el, message, tone = 'info') {
+  el.textContent = message;
+  el.dataset.tone = tone;
+  el.hidden = !message;
+}
+
+function formatDate(epochMs) {
+  const date = new Date(epochMs);
+  return { text: dateFormat.format(date), iso: date.toISOString() };
+}
+
+function renderCredentials(list) {
+  els.list.replaceChildren();
+  els.list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+  els.empty.hidden = list.length > 0;
+
+  const sorted = [...list].sort((a, b) => (b.registeredAt || 0) - (a.registeredAt || 0));
+  for (const cred of sorted) {
+    const row = els.rowTemplate.content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
+    row.dataset.id = cred.id;
+
+    const icon = row.querySelector('.passkey-icon');
+    if (cred.providerIcon) {
+      const img = document.createElement('img');
+      img.src = cred.providerIcon;
+      img.alt = '';
+      img.width = 32;
+      img.height = 32;
+      icon.replaceChildren(img);
+    }
+
+    const label = cred.name?.trim() || cred.providerName || 'Passkey';
+    row.querySelector('.passkey-name').textContent = label;
+
+    const providerEl = row.querySelector('.passkey-provider');
+    const showProvider = cred.providerName && cred.providerName !== label;
+    providerEl.textContent = showProvider ? cred.providerName : '';
+    providerEl.hidden = !showProvider;
+
+    const added = row.querySelector('.passkey-added time');
+    if (cred.registeredAt) {
+      const { text, iso } = formatDate(cred.registeredAt);
+      added.textContent = text;
+      added.dateTime = iso;
+    } else {
+      added.replaceWith('unknown');
+    }
+
+    const used = row.querySelector('.passkey-used time');
+    if (cred.lastUsedAt) {
+      const { text, iso } = formatDate(cred.lastUsedAt);
+      used.textContent = text;
+      used.dateTime = iso;
+    } else {
+      used.replaceWith('not yet');
+    }
+
+    const badge = row.querySelector('.passkey-badge');
+    if (cred.credentialDeviceType === 'multiDevice' || cred.credentialBackedUp) {
+      badge.textContent = 'Synced';
+      badge.title = 'Backed up by your passkey provider and available on your other devices.';
+    } else {
+      badge.textContent = 'This device only';
+      badge.title = 'Stored only on the device or security key where it was created.';
+    }
+
+    row.querySelector('.rename-btn').setAttribute('aria-label', `Rename passkey ${label}`);
+    row.querySelector('.delete-btn').setAttribute('aria-label', `Delete passkey ${label}`);
+    els.list.append(row);
+  }
+}
+
+async function refreshCredentials() {
+  credentials = await api.listCredentials();
+  renderCredentials(credentials);
+  return credentials;
+}
+
+// ---------- actions ----------
+
+function findCredential(id) {
+  return credentials.find((c) => c.id === id);
+}
+
+function openRename(cred) {
+  pendingCredentialId = cred.id;
+  els.renameInput.value = cred.name || cred.providerName || '';
+  els.renameError.textContent = '';
+  els.renameDialog.returnValue = '';
+  els.renameDialog.showModal();
+  els.renameInput.select();
+}
+
+function openDelete(cred) {
+  pendingCredentialId = cred.id;
+  els.deleteName.textContent = cred.name || cred.providerName || 'this passkey';
+  els.deleteDialog.returnValue = '';
+  els.deleteDialog.showModal();
+}
+
+async function performRename(id, newName) {
+  const cred = findCredential(id);
+  if (!cred) return;
+  const previous = cred.name;
+  try {
+    await api.renameCredential(id, newName);
+    await refreshCredentials();
+    setStatus(els.status, `Renamed “${previous}” to “${newName}”.`, 'success');
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(err);
+    setStatus(els.status, `Could not rename passkey: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+  }
+}
+
+async function performDelete(id) {
+  const cred = findCredential(id);
+  if (!cred) return;
+  const label = cred.name || cred.providerName;
+  try {
+    await api.deleteCredential(id);
+    const remaining = await refreshCredentials();
+    // Tell the browser / password manager which passkeys are still valid so it
+    // can hide or remove the one we just deleted.
+    await syncAcceptedCredentials(remaining);
+    setStatus(els.status, `Deleted passkey “${label}”.`, 'success');
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(err);
+    setStatus(els.status, `Could not delete passkey: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+  } finally {
+    // The row that held the Delete button is gone, so focus the section
+    // heading rather than letting focus fall back to <body>.
+    els.heading.focus();
+  }
+}
+
+async function registerPasskey() {
+  setStatus(els.status, '');
+  els.createBtn.disabled = true;
+  try {
+    const optionsJSON = await api.registrationOptions();
+    const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(optionsJSON);
+
+    let credential;
+    try {
+      credential = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey });
+    } catch (err) {
+      switch (err.name) {
+        case 'InvalidStateError':
+          setStatus(els.status, 'This device already has a passkey for your account.', 'info');
+          break;
+        case 'NotAllowedError':
+        case 'AbortError':
+          // User cancelled or timed out: nothing to report.
+          break;
+        case 'SecurityError':
+          setStatus(els.status, 'Passkeys need a secure (HTTPS) connection on this site’s domain.', 'error');
+          break;
+        default:
+          console.error(err);
+          setStatus(els.status, `Could not create a passkey: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+      }
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const registration = credential.toJSON();
+    try {
+      await api.verifyRegistration(registration);
+    } catch (err) {
+      // The authenticator saved a passkey the server will never accept:
+      // ask the password manager to drop it.
+      console.error(err);
+      await signalUnknownCredential(registration.id);
+      setStatus(els.status, `Your passkey could not be saved: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const list = await refreshCredentials();
+    await syncAcceptedCredentials(list);
+    setStatus(els.status, 'Passkey created. You can rename it below.', 'success');
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(err);
+    setStatus(els.status, `Could not start passkey setup: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+  } finally {
+    els.createBtn.disabled = false;
+  }
+}
+
+async function saveProfile(event) {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  const displayName = els.profileDisplayName.value.trim();
+  if (!displayName) {
+    els.profileDisplayName.setCustomValidity('Please enter a display name.');
+    els.profileDisplayName.reportValidity();
+    return;
+  }
+  els.profileDisplayName.setCustomValidity('');
+  const submit = els.profileForm.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
+  submit.disabled = true;
+  try {
+    user = { ...user, ...(await api.updateUser({ name: user.name, displayName })) };
+    els.welcomeName.textContent = user.displayName;
+    // Keep the name shown in the passkey picker in step with the account.
+    await syncUserDetails();
+    setStatus(els.profileStatus, 'Display name updated.', 'success');
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(err);
+    setStatus(els.profileStatus, `Could not update display name: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+  } finally {
+    submit.disabled = false;
+  }
+}
+
+// ---------- wiring ----------
+
+function wireEvents() {
+  els.list.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
+    const button = event.target.closest('button');
+    if (!button) return;
+    const row = button.closest('[data-id]');
+    const cred = row && findCredential(row.dataset.id);
+    if (!cred) return;
+    if (button.classList.contains('rename-btn')) openRename(cred);
+    else if (button.classList.contains('delete-btn')) openDelete(cred);
+  });
+
+  els.renameForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
+    // Only the Save button carries value="save"; validate before the dialog closes.
+    if (event.submitter?.value !== 'save') return;
+    const value = els.renameInput.value.trim();
+    if (!value) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      els.renameError.textContent = 'Please enter a name.';
+      els.renameInput.focus();
+    }
+  });
+
+  els.renameDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
+    const choice = els.renameDialog.returnValue;
+    els.renameDialog.returnValue = '';
+    const id = pendingCredentialId;
+    pendingCredentialId = null;
+    if (choice === 'save' && id) {
+      const value = els.renameInput.value.trim();
+      const cred = findCredential(id);
+      if (cred && value && value !== cred.name) performRename(id, value);
+    }
+  });
+
+  els.deleteDialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
+    const choice = els.deleteDialog.returnValue;
+    els.deleteDialog.returnValue = '';
+    const id = pendingCredentialId;
+    pendingCredentialId = null;
+    if (choice === 'delete' && id) performDelete(id);
+  });
+
+  els.createBtn.addEventListener('click', registerPasskey);
+  els.profileForm.addEventListener('submit', saveProfile);
+  els.profileDisplayName.addEventListener('input', () => els.profileDisplayName.setCustomValidity(''));
+}
+
+async function init() {
+  wireEvents();
+  try {
+    ({ api, user } = await selectApi());
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(err);
+    els.list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+    setStatus(els.status, `We couldn’t load your account right now: ${err.message}`, 'error');
+    return;
+  }
+  if (!user.rpId) user.rpId = location.hostname;
+
+  els.welcomeName.textContent = user.displayName;

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// Builds account/aaguids.json from the community AAGUID registry.
+//
+// The upstream file is ~7 MB because every entry embeds light/dark icons as
+// data URIs. We keep the provider *name* for every entry (so any passkey can be
+// labelled) but only ship icons for the common consumer providers listed below.
+//
+// Usage:  node scripts/build-aaguids.mjs [path/to/combined_aaguid.json]
+// With no argument the registry is downloaded from GitHub.
+
+import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+const REGISTRY_URL =
+  'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids/refs/heads/main/combined_aaguid.json';
+
+// Providers whose icons are worth the bytes on a consumer site.
+const ICON_ALLOWLIST = new Set([
+  'ea9b8d66-4d01-1d21-3ce4-b6b48cb575d4', // Google Password Manager
+  'adce0002-35bc-c60a-648b-0b25f1f05503', // Chrome on Mac
+  'fbfc3007-154e-4ecc-8c0b-6e020557d7bd', // Apple Passwords / iCloud Keychain
+  'dd4ec289-e01d-41c9-bb89-70fa845d4bf2', // iCloud Keychain (Managed)
+  '08987058-cadc-4b81-b6e1-30de50dcbe96', // Windows Hello
+  '9ddd1817-af5a-4672-a2b9-3e3dd95000a9', // Windows Hello
+  '771b48fd-d3d4-4f74-9232-fc157ab0507a', // Edge on Mac
+  'bada5566-a7aa-401f-bd96-45619a55120d', // 1Password
+  'd548826e-79b4-db40-a3d8-11116f7e8349', // Bitwarden
+  '531126d6-e717-415c-9320-3d9aa6981239', // Dashlane
+  'b84e4048-15dc-4dd0-8640-f4f60813c8af', // NordPass
+  '0ea242b4-43c4-4a1b-8b17-dd6d0b6baec6', // Keeper
+  'f3809540-7f14-49c1-a8b3-8f813b225541', // Enpass
+  '53414d53-554e-4700-0000-000000000000', // Samsung Pass
+]);
+
+const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
+const outFile = path.join(here, '..', 'account', 'aaguids.json');
+
+async function loadRegistry(arg) {
+  if (arg) return JSON.parse(await readFile(arg, 'utf8'));
+  const res = await fetch(REGISTRY_URL);
+  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Registry download failed: ${res.status}`);
+  return res.json();
+}
+
+const registry = await loadRegistry(process.argv[2]);
+const trimmed = {};
+for (const [aaguid, entry] of Object.entries(registry)) {
+  if (!entry?.name) continue;
+  const out = { name: entry.name };
+  if (ICON_ALLOWLIST.has(aaguid)) {
+    if (entry.icon_light) out.icon_light = entry.icon_light;
+    if (entry.icon_dark) out.icon_dark = entry.icon_dark;
+  }
+  trimmed[aaguid] = out;
+}
+
+await writeFile(outFile, JSON.stringify(trimmed) + '\n');
+console.log(`Wrote ${Object.keys(trimmed).length} providers to ${path.relative(process.cwd(), outFile)}`);

+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static marketing homepage for The Daily Grind Coffee Co. The **My Account** panel
+(top navigation) lets customers create an account, sign in, manage their saved
+passkeys, update their profile, and re-verify their identity, all with passkeys
+(WebAuthn) instead of passwords.
+
+```sh
+pnpm start   # static server on http://localhost:11222
+```
+
+## Passkey features
+
+| Flow | Where | Notes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Registration | "Create an account" | Creates the account and its first passkey in one step (`residentKey: required`, platform authenticator). |
+| Sign-in | "Sign in" | Discoverable credentials via the **Sign in with a passkey** button, plus browser autofill (conditional UI) on the email field. |
+| Management | "Passkeys" panel | Lists provider icon/name (from AAGUID), added and last-used dates; rename, remove, and **Add a passkey** (security keys allowed). |
+| Profile updates | "Profile" panel | Updates username (email) and display name and syncs them to the passkey provider with `signalCurrentUserDetails()`. |
+| Reauthentication | Profile save, passkey removal, "Verify it's you" | Step-up prompt limited to the user's own passkeys; the server requires a verification newer than 5 minutes. |
+
+Password-manager sync uses the WebAuthn Signal API where available:
+`signalAllAcceptedCredentials()` on load and after deletions,
+`signalUnknownCredential()` when the server rejects or does not know a credential,
+and `signalCurrentUserDetails()` after profile changes.
+
+## Code layout
+
+| File | Purpose |
+| --- | --- |
+| `js/account.js` | UI controller for the account dialog. |
+| `js/passkeys.js` | WebAuthn client flows (create/get, conditional UI, reauth, Signal API). |
+| `js/api.js` | HTTP client; returns `Response` objects. |
+| `js/demo-backend.js` | **Browser-side stand-in for the server** used when `API_MODE = 'local-demo'`. |
+| `js/aaguid.js`, `data/aaguids.json` | Passkey provider names/icons (trimmed community AAGUID registry). |
+| `js/config.js` | RP ID, API mode, reauth freshness window. |
+| `styles/account.css` | Dialog, forms, passkey list. |
+
+## Connecting a real backend
+
+This repository has no server, so `js/demo-backend.js` emulates one inside the
+browser (accounts in `localStorage`, session in `sessionStorage`, signature checks
+with WebCrypto). That is enough to exercise every flow on `http://localhost`, but
+it is not a security boundary. For production:
+
+1. Implement the endpoints below with a vetted WebAuthn library (for example
+   [SimpleWebAuthn](https://github.com/MasterKale/SimpleWebAuthn)).
+2. Set `API_MODE = 'remote'` (and `API_BASE` if needed) in `js/config.js`.
+3. Serve the site over HTTPS with an RP ID that matches the hostname.
+
+All credential and user IDs are Base64URL strings. Requests and responses are JSON;
+`*/verify` bodies are the output of `PublicKeyCredential.prototype.toJSON()`.
+
+| Method & path | Auth | Request → Response |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `GET /api/session` | – | → `{ user, signedInAt, reauthAt }` or `401` |
+| `POST /api/logout` | – | → `{ success }` |
+| `POST /api/signup/options` | – | `{ name, email }` → creation options (`409` if email exists) |
+| `POST /api/register/options` | session | `{ promotion }` → creation options with `excludeCredentials` |
+| `POST /api/register/verify` | session or pending sign-up | attestation JSON → `201 { user, credential }`; non-2xx triggers `signalUnknownCredential()` |
+| `POST /api/signin/options` | – | → request options with `allowCredentials: []` |
+| `POST /api/signin/verify` | – | assertion JSON → `{ user, signedInAt, reauthAt }`; `404` if credential unknown |
+| `POST /api/reauth/options` | session | → request options with `allowCredentials` = the user's passkeys |
+| `POST /api/reauth/verify` | session | assertion JSON → `{ verified, reauthAt }`; must reject other users' passkeys |
+| `GET /api/credentials` | session | → `StoredPasskeyCredential[]` (no key material) |
+| `PUT /api/credential/:id` | session | `{ name }` → credential |
+| `DELETE /api/credential/:id` | session + fresh reauth | → `{ success }`; `401 { code: "reauth_required" }` when stale |
+| `PUT /api/user` | session + fresh reauth | `{ name, displayName }` → user |
+
+Server-side rules the client relies on: challenges are random, single-use and
+bound to the session; `userVerification: "preferred"` is verified with
+`requireUserVerification: false`; user presence is required; unknown credentials
+return `404`; stale reauthentication returns `401` with `code: "reauth_required"`.

+/**
+ * AAGUID -> passkey provider lookup.
+ *
+ * The AAGUID identifies the authenticator *model* (Google Password Manager,
+ * iCloud Keychain, 1Password, a YubiKey series...). It is used strictly as a
+ * UX hint for naming and icons in the passkey list; it carries no security
+ * meaning because platform passkeys do not attest it.
+ *
+ * data/aaguids.json is a trimmed copy of the community registry at
+ * https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids
+ * containing common consumer providers (the full file is ~7 MB of icons).
+ */
+
+export const ZERO_AAGUID = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
+
+let registryPromise;
+
+function loadRegistry() {
+  registryPromise ??= fetch(new URL('../data/aaguids.json', import.meta.url))
+    .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : {}))
+    .catch(() => ({}));
+  return registryPromise;
+}
+
+/** Best-effort device description for authenticators that report a zeroed AAGUID. */
+function deviceNameFromUserAgent() {
+  const platform = navigator.userAgentData?.platform || '';
+  const ua = navigator.userAgent;
+  const label =
+    platform ||
+    (/iPhone/.test(ua) && 'iPhone') ||
+    (/iPad/.test(ua) && 'iPad') ||
+    (/Android/.test(ua) && 'Android') ||
+    (/Macintosh/.test(ua) && 'Mac') ||
+    (/Windows/.test(ua) && 'Windows') ||
+    (/CrOS/.test(ua) && 'ChromeOS') ||
+    (/Linux/.test(ua) && 'Linux') ||
+    '';
+  return label ? `Passkey on ${label}` : 'Unknown passkey provider';
+}
+
+/**
+ * Resolve provider metadata for a registration.
+ * @returns {Promise<{name: string, providerIcon?: string}>}
+ */
+export async function providerForAaguid(aaguid) {
+  if (!aaguid || aaguid === ZERO_AAGUID) {
+    return { name: deviceNameFromUserAgent(), providerIcon: undefined };
+  }
+  const registry = await loadRegistry();
+  const provider = registry[aaguid.toLowerCase()];
+  return {
+    name: provider?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider',
+    providerIcon: provider?.icon_light,
+  };
+}

+  confirmDialog: $('confirm-dialog'),
+  confirmText: $('confirm-text'),

+  reauthCancel: $('reauth-cancel'),

+  user: null,
+  reauthAt: null,
+  credentials: [],
+  support: { supported: false, platformAuthenticator: false, conditionalGet: false },
+};
+
+/* ---------- small UI helpers ---------- */
+
+function setStatus(message, kind = 'info') {
+  el.status.textContent = message ?? '';
+  el.status.className = message ? `status status--${kind}` : 'status';
+}
+
+async function withBusy(button, task) {
+  button.disabled = true;

+  try {
+    return await task();
+  } finally {
+    button.disabled = false;
+    button.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
+  }
+}
+
+const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium' });
+const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
+const relativeFormatter = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(undefined, { numeric: 'auto' });
+
+function formatRelativeMinutes(timestamp) {
+  const minutes = Math.round((timestamp - Date.now()) / 60000);
+  return minutes === 0 ? 'just now' : relativeFormatter.format(minutes, 'minute');
+}
+
+/** Wait for a dialog to close and resolve with the button value that closed it ('' = dismissed). */
+function awaitDialogClose(dialog) {

+    dialog.addEventListener(

+      () => {
+        const value = dialog.returnValue;
+        dialog.returnValue = '';
+        resolve(value);
+      },
+      { once: true },
+    );
+  });

+
+function friendlyError(err, fallback) {

+

+        setStatus('Sign-in cancelled. You can try again whenever you are ready.', 'info');
+      } else if (err instanceof PasskeyError && err.code === 'unknown_credential') {
+        setStatus(`${err.message} Create an account to get started.`, 'error');
+      } else {
+        setStatus(friendlyError(err, 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.'), 'error');
+      }
+      // Re-arm autofill suggestions after an explicit prompt ends without a session.
+      armConditionalSignIn();
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+el.signupForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!el.signupForm.reportValidity()) return;
+  const button = el.signupForm.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
+  const details = {
+    name: el.signupForm.elements.name.value.trim(),
+    email: el.signupForm.elements.email.value.trim(),
+  };
+  withBusy(button, async () => {
+    setStatus('');
+    try {
+      const result = await registerPasskey({ flow: 'signup', details });
+      await handleSignedIn(
+        { user: result.user, reauthAt: Date.now() },
+        `Welcome to The Daily Grind, ${result.user.displayName}! Your passkey is ready for next time.`,
+      );
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err instanceof PasskeyError && err.code === 'cancelled') {
+        setStatus('Passkey setup was cancelled, so no account was created yet.', 'info');
+      } else {
+        setStatus(friendlyError(err, 'We could not create your account. Please try again.'), 'error');
+      }
+      armConditionalSignIn();
+    }
+  });
+});
+
+/* ---------- signed-in actions ---------- */
+
+el.profileForm.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!el.profileForm.reportValidity()) return;
+  const button = el.profileForm.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
+  const displayName = el.profileName.value.trim();
+  const name = el.profileEmail.value.trim();
+  withBusy(button, async () => {
+    setStatus('');
+    const response = await withReauth('Use your passkey to confirm these profile changes.', () =>
+      api.updateUser({ name, displayName }),
+    );
+    if (!response) return;
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      const { message } = await errorFromResponse(response, 'Could not update your profile.');
+      setStatus(message, 'error');
+      return;
+    }
+    state.user = await response.json();
+    renderSignedInView();
+    // Push the new username / display name to the passkey provider.
+    await signalCurrentUserDetails(state.user.id, state.user.name, state.user.displayName);
+    setStatus('Profile updated.', 'success');
+  });
+});
+
+el.addPasskey.addEventListener('click', () =>
+  withBusy(el.addPasskey, async () => {
+    setStatus('');
+    try {
+      const { credential } = await registerPasskey({ flow: 'manage' });
+      await loadCredentials();
+      setStatus(`Passkey saved with ${credential.name}.`, 'success');
+    } catch (err) {
+      if (err instanceof PasskeyError && err.code === 'cancelled') {
+        setStatus('Passkey creation was cancelled.', 'info');
+      } else if (err instanceof PasskeyError && err.code === 'unauthenticated') {
+        handleSignedOut('Your session ended. Please sign in again.');
+      } else {
+        setStatus(friendlyError(err, 'Could not add a passkey.'), 'error');
+      }
+    }
+  }),
+);
+
+async function renameCredential(cred) {
+  el.renameInput.value = cred.name;
+  el.renameDialog.showModal();
+  el.renameInput.select();
+  const result = await awaitDialogClose(el.renameDialog);
+  if (result !== 'save') return;
+  const newName = el.renameInput.value.trim();
+  if (!newName || newName === cred.name) return;
+  const response = await api.renameCredential(cred.id, newName);
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    const { message } = await errorFromResponse(response, 'Could not rename the passkey.');
+    setStatus(message, 'error');
+    return;
+  }
+  await loadCredentials();
+  setStatus(`Passkey renamed to “${newName}”.`, 'success');
+}
+
+async function deleteCredential(cred) {
+  el.confirmText.textContent = `“${cred.name}” will no longer sign you in. You should also delete it from your password manager.`;
+  el.confirmDialog.showModal();
+  if ((await awaitDialogClose(el.confirmDialog)) !== 'confirm') return;
+  const response = await withReauth('Use your passkey to confirm removing a passkey.', () =>
+    api.deleteCredential(cred.id),
+  );
+  if (!response) return;
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    const { message } = await errorFromResponse(response, 'Could not remove the passkey.');
+    setStatus(message, 'error');
+    return;
+  }
+  // loadCredentials() re-signals the remaining accepted credential IDs.
+  await loadCredentials();
+  setStatus('Passkey removed.', 'success');
+}
+
+el.passkeyList.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
+  const button = event.target.closest('button');
+  const row = event.target.closest('.passkey-row');
+  if (!button || !row) return;
+  const cred = state.credentials.find((c) => c.id === row.dataset.id);
+  if (!cred) return;
+  setStatus('');
+  withBusy(button, () => (button.classList.contains('rename') ? renameCredential(cred) : deleteCredential(cred)));
+});
+
+el.verifyNow.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  setStatus('');
+  if (await promptReauth('Confirm it is really you with your passkey.')) setStatus('Thanks, your identity is verified.', 'success');
+});
+
+el.signOut.addEventListener('click', () =>
+  withBusy(el.signOut, async () => {
+    await api.logout();
+    handleSignedOut('You are signed out.');
+  }),
+);
+
+/* ---------- opening / closing the dialog ---------- */
+
+function openAccountDialog() {
+  if (el.dialog.open) return;
+  setStatus('');
+  renderView();
+  el.dialog.showModal();
+  if (state.user) loadCredentials();
+  else armConditionalSignIn();
+}
+
+el.accountLink.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  openAccountDialog();
+});
+el.sessionButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (!state.user) return openAccountDialog();
+  await api.logout();
+  handleSignedOut();
+  el.dialog.close();
+});
+el.dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
+  el.dialog.returnValue = '';
+  if (location.hash === '#account') history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search);
+});
+
+// closedby="any" is not yet supported everywhere (e.g. Safari): emulate light dismiss.
+if (!('closedBy' in HTMLDialogElement.prototype)) {
+  const outside = (e, dialog) => {
+    const r = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
+    return e.clientX < r.left || e.clientX > r.right || e.clientY < r.top || e.clientY > r.bottom;
+  };
+  for (const dialog of document.querySelectorAll('dialog[closedby="any"]')) {
+    let pressedOutside = false;
+    dialog.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => { pressedOutside = outside(e, dialog); });
+    dialog.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => { if (pressedOutside && outside(e, dialog)) dialog.close(); });
+  }
+}
+
+/* ---------- boot ---------- */
+
+async function init() {
+  state.support = await getPasskeySupport();
+  try {
+    const response = await api.getSession();
+    if (response.ok) {
+      const session = await response.json();
+      state.user = session.user;
+      state.reauthAt = session.reauthAt ?? null;
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('Could not restore session:', err);
+  }
+  renderView();
+  if (state.user) {
+    // Sync accepted credentials with the password manager as soon as we know who is signed in.
+    loadCredentials();
+  } else {
+    armConditionalSignIn();
+  }
+  if (location.hash === '#account') openAccountDialog();
+}
+
+init();

+/**
+ * Account API client.
+ *
+ * Every method returns a `Response`, whether it came from `fetch()` against a
+ * real server (API_MODE = 'remote') or from the in-browser stand-in
+ * (API_MODE = 'local-demo'). See README.md for the endpoint contract.
+ */
+import { API_BASE, API_MODE } from './config.js';
+
+let demoBackend;
+
+async function request(method, path, body) {
+  if (API_MODE === 'local-demo') {
+    demoBackend ??= await import('./demo-backend.js');
+    return demoBackend.handle(method, API_BASE + path, body);
+  }
+  const init = { method, credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } };
+  if (body !== undefined) {
+    init.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
+    init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
+  }
+  return fetch(API_BASE + path, init);
+}
+
+const credentialPath = (id) => `/credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`;
+
+export const api = {
+  getSession: () => request('GET', '/session'),
+  logout: () => request('POST', '/logout'),
+
+  // Registration
+  signupOptions: (details) => request('POST', '/signup/options', details),
+  registerOptions: (opts = {}) => request('POST', '/register/options', opts),
+  registerVerify: (credentialJSON) => request('POST', '/register/verify', credentialJSON),
+
+  // Authentication
+  signinOptions: () => request('POST', '/signin/options'),
+  signinVerify: (credentialJSON) => request('POST', '/signin/verify', credentialJSON),
+
+  // Reauthentication (step-up)
+  reauthOptions: () => request('POST', '/reauth/options'),
+  reauthVerify: (credentialJSON) => request('POST', '/reauth/verify', credentialJSON),
+
+  // Management
+  listCredentials: () => request('GET', '/credentials'),
+  renameCredential: (id, name) => request('PUT', credentialPath(id), { name }),
+  deleteCredential: (id) => request('DELETE', credentialPath(id)),
+  updateUser: (details) => request('PUT', '/user', details),
+};
+
+/** Read a JSON error message from a failed response, if any. */
+export async function errorFromResponse(response, fallback = 'Something went wrong. Please try again.') {
+  try {
+    const data = await response.clone().json();
+    return { message: data?.error || fallback, code: data?.code };
+  } catch {
+    return { message: fallback };
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * Shared passkey configuration for The Daily Grind.
+ *
+ * RP_ID must match (or be a registrable suffix of) the page's hostname, and
+ * the same value must be used by whatever generates WebAuthn options.
+ */
+export const RP_ID = location.hostname;
+export const RP_NAME = 'The Daily Grind';
+
+/**
+ * Where the account API lives.
+ *
+ *  - 'local-demo': this project is a static site with no backend, so the
+ *    relying-party endpoints are emulated in the browser by js/demo-backend.js
+ *    (accounts and passkeys are stored in this browser's localStorage).
+ *  - 'remote': talk to real HTTP endpoints under API_BASE (see README.md for
+ *    the contract). Use this once a server built on a vetted WebAuthn
+ *    library (e.g. SimpleWebAuthn) is available.
+ */
+export const API_MODE = 'local-demo';
+export const API_BASE = '/api';
+
+/** How long a passkey reauthentication stays "fresh" for sensitive actions. */
+export const REAUTH_MAX_AGE_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

+/**
+ * In-browser stand-in for The Daily Grind account server.
+ *
+ * This project is a static site, so the relying-party (RP) endpoints that a
+ * passkey deployment needs are emulated here. It implements the same HTTP
+ * contract the client expects from a real backend (see README.md) and returns
+ * standard `Response` objects, so js/api.js can swap it for `fetch()` with a
+ * one-line config change.
+ *
+ * It keeps accounts and passkeys in localStorage and the session in
+ * sessionStorage, generates random challenges, checks origin / RP ID hash /
+ * user presence / signature counters, and verifies assertion signatures with
+ * WebCrypto. That makes the UI fully exercisable on http://localhost, but it
+ * is NOT a security boundary: anything that runs in the page can edit it.
+ * A production deployment must do all of this on a server using a vetted
+ * library such as SimpleWebAuthn.
+ */
+
+import { RP_ID, RP_NAME, REAUTH_MAX_AGE_MS } from './config.js';
+import { providerForAaguid } from './aaguid.js';
+import {
+  base64UrlToBytes,
+  bufferToBase64Url,
+  bytesEqual,
+  bytesToUuid,
+  concatBytes,
+  randomBase64Url,
+  utf8Decode,
+  utf8Encode,
+} from './util.js';
+
+const USERS_KEY = 'dg.rp.users';
+const CREDENTIALS_KEY = 'dg.rp.credentials';
+const SESSION_KEY = 'dg.rp.session';
+const CHALLENGES_KEY = 'dg.rp.challenges';
+const CHALLENGE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
+const PENDING_USER_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
+
+const COSE_ES256 = -7;
+const COSE_RS256 = -257;
+
+/* ---------- storage ---------- */
+
+function read(storage, key, fallback) {
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(storage.getItem(key)) ?? fallback;
+  } catch {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+}
+const write = (storage, key, value) => storage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
+
+const getUsers = () => read(localStorage, USERS_KEY, {});
+const saveUsers = (users) => write(localStorage, USERS_KEY, users);
+const getCredentials = () => read(localStorage, CREDENTIALS_KEY, {});
+const saveCredentials = (creds) => write(localStorage, CREDENTIALS_KEY, creds);
+const getSession = () => read(sessionStorage, SESSION_KEY, null);
+const saveSession = (session) =>
+  session ? write(sessionStorage, SESSION_KEY, session) : sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
+
+/* ---------- challenges (one-time, short lived, bound to a flow) ---------- */
+
+function issueChallenge(flow, extra = {}) {
+  const now = Date.now();
+  const all = read(sessionStorage, CHALLENGES_KEY, {});
+  for (const [key, record] of Object.entries(all)) if (record.exp < now) delete all[key];
+  const challenge = randomBase64Url(32);
+  all[challenge] = { flow, exp: now + CHALLENGE_TTL_MS, ...extra };
+  write(sessionStorage, CHALLENGES_KEY, all);
+  return challenge;
+}
+
+function consumeChallenge(challenge, flows) {
+  const all = read(sessionStorage, CHALLENGES_KEY, {});
+  const record = all[challenge];
+  if (record) {
+    delete all[challenge];
+    write(sessionStorage, CHALLENGES_KEY, all);
+  }
+  if (!record || ![flows].flat().includes(record.flow) || record.exp < Date.now()) return null;
+  return record;
+}
+
+/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
+
+const json = (status, data) =>
+  new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
+const error = (status, message, extra = {}) => json(status, { error: message, ...extra });
+
+const sha256 = async (bytes) => new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes));
+
+function publicUser(user) {
+  return { id: user.id, name: user.name, displayName: user.displayName, createdAt: user.createdAt };
+}
+
+function publicCredential(cred) {
+  const { publicKeyJwk, credentialPublicKey, ...rest } = cred;
+  return rest;
+}
+
+function credentialsForUser(userId) {
+  return Object.values(getCredentials())
+    .filter((c) => c.passkeyUserId === userId)
+    .sort((a, b) => a.registeredAt - b.registeredAt);
+}
+
+function findActiveUserByEmail(email) {
+  const needle = email.trim().toLowerCase();
+  return Object.values(getUsers()).find((u) => u.active && u.name.toLowerCase() === needle);
+}
+
+function requireSession() {
+  const session = getSession();
+  if (!session) return { response: error(401, 'Sign in to continue.', { code: 'unauthenticated' }) };
+  const user = getUsers()[session.userId];
+  if (!user || !user.active) {
+    saveSession(null);
+    return { response: error(401, 'Sign in to continue.', { code: 'unauthenticated' }) };
+  }
+  return { session, user };
+}
+
+function requireFreshReauth(session) {
+  if (!session.reauthAt || Date.now() - session.reauthAt > REAUTH_MAX_AGE_MS) {
+    return error(401, 'Please verify your identity to make this change.', { code: 'reauth_required' });
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+function parseClientData(clientDataJSONB64, expectedType) {
+  const clientData = JSON.parse(utf8Decode(base64UrlToBytes(clientDataJSONB64)));
+  if (clientData.type !== expectedType) throw new Error('Unexpected client data type.');
+  if (clientData.origin !== location.origin) throw new Error('Origin mismatch.');
+  return clientData;
+}
+
+function parseAuthenticatorData(bytes) {
+  if (bytes.length < 37) throw new Error('Authenticator data too short.');
+  const flags = bytes[32];
+  const parsed = {
+    rpIdHash: bytes.slice(0, 32),
+    userPresent: Boolean(flags & 0x01),
+    userVerified: Boolean(flags & 0x04),
+    backupEligible: Boolean(flags & 0x08),
+    backedUp: Boolean(flags & 0x10),
+    counter: new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset + 33, 4).getUint32(0),
+  };
+  if (flags & 0x40 && bytes.length >= 55) {
+    parsed.aaguid = bytesToUuid(bytes.slice(37, 53));
+    const idLength = (bytes[53] << 8) | bytes[54];
+    parsed.credentialId = bytes.slice(55, 55 + idLength);
+  }
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+async function assertRpIdHash(authData) {
+  const expected = await sha256(utf8Encode(RP_ID));
+  if (!bytesEqual(authData.rpIdHash, expected)) throw new Error('RP ID mismatch.');
+}
+
+function importParams(alg) {
+  if (alg === COSE_ES256) return { name: 'ECDSA', namedCurve: 'P-256' };
+  if (alg === COSE_RS256) return { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5', hash: 'SHA-256' };
+  throw new Error('Unsupported public key algorithm.');
+}
+
+/** WebAuthn ECDSA signatures are DER encoded; WebCrypto expects raw r||s. */
+function derToRawEcdsa(sig) {
+  if (sig.length === 64) return sig;
+  let offset = 2;
+  if (sig[1] & 0x80) offset += sig[1] & 0x7f;
+  const readInteger = () => {
+    if (sig[offset++] !== 0x02) throw new Error('Malformed signature.');
+    const length = sig[offset++];
+    let value = sig.slice(offset, offset + length);
+    offset += length;
+    while (value.length > 32 && value[0] === 0) value = value.slice(1);
+    const out = new Uint8Array(32);
+    out.set(value, 32 - value.length);
+    return out;
+  };
+  return concatBytes(readInteger(), readInteger());
+}
+
+async function verifyAssertionSignature(cred, authDataBytes, clientDataJSONB64, signatureB64) {
+  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', cred.publicKeyJwk, importParams(cred.alg), false, ['verify']);
+  const signedData = concatBytes(authDataBytes, await sha256(base64UrlToBytes(clientDataJSONB64)));
+  let signature = base64UrlToBytes(signatureB64);
+  let params;
+  if (cred.alg === COSE_ES256) {
+    signature = derToRawEcdsa(signature);
+    params = { name: 'ECDSA', hash: 'SHA-256' };
+  } else {
+    params = { name: 'RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5' };
+  }
+  return crypto.subtle.verify(params, key, signature, signedData);
+}
+
+/* ---------- option builders ---------- */
+
+function creationOptions(user, { promotion }) {
+  const existing = credentialsForUser(user.id);
+  const options = {
+    challenge: issueChallenge(user.active ? 'register' : 'signup', { userId: user.id }),
+    rp: { id: RP_ID, name: RP_NAME },
+    user: { id: user.id, name: user.name, displayName: user.displayName },
+    pubKeyCredParams: [
+      { type: 'public-key', alg: COSE_ES256 },
+      { type: 'public-key', alg: COSE_RS256 },
+    ],
+    excludeCredentials: existing.map((c) => ({ type: 'public-key', id: c.id, transports: c.transports })),
+    authenticatorSelection: {
+      residentKey: 'required',
+      requireResidentKey: true,
+      userVerification: 'preferred',
+      // Promotion flows (first passkey at sign-up) steer to the platform
+      // authenticator; the management panel also allows security keys.
+      ...(promotion && { authenticatorAttachment: 'platform' }),
+    },
+    attestation: 'none',
+    timeout: 120000,
+  };
+  return options;
+}
+
+/* ---------- route handlers ---------- */
+
+async function handleSession() {
+  const session = getSession();
+  if (!session) return error(401, 'Not signed in.', { code: 'unauthenticated' });
+  const user = getUsers()[session.userId];
+  if (!user || !user.active) {
+    saveSession(null);
+    return error(401, 'Not signed in.', { code: 'unauthenticated' });
+  }
+  return json(200, { user: publicUser(user), signedInAt: session.signedInAt, reauthAt: session.reauthAt });
+}
+
+async function handleSignupOptions(body) {
+  const displayName = String(body?.name ?? '').trim();
+  const email = String(body?.email ?? '').trim();
+  if (!displayName || !email) return error(400, 'Name and email are required.');
+  if (findActiveUserByEmail(email)) {
+    return error(409, 'An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.', { code: 'exists' });
+  }
+  const users = getUsers();
+  const now = Date.now();
+  for (const [id, u] of Object.entries(users)) {
+    if (!u.active && (u.createdAt < now - PENDING_USER_TTL_MS || u.name.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
+      delete users[id];
+    }
+  }
+  const user = { id: randomBase64Url(16), name: email, displayName, createdAt: now, active: false };
+  users[user.id] = user;
+  saveUsers(users);
+  return json(200, creationOptions(user, { promotion: true }));
+}
+
+async function handleRegisterOptions(body) {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  return json(200, creationOptions(auth.user, { promotion: Boolean(body?.promotion) }));
+}
+
+async function handleRegisterVerify(body) {
+  try {
+    const response = body?.response ?? {};
+    const clientData = parseClientData(response.clientDataJSON, 'webauthn.create');
+    const record = consumeChallenge(clientData.challenge, ['signup', 'register']);
+    if (!record) return error(400, 'Registration challenge expired. Please try again.');
+
+    if (!response.authenticatorData || !response.publicKey) {
+      return error(400, 'This browser did not return the passkey public key.');
+    }
+    const authData = parseAuthenticatorData(base64UrlToBytes(response.authenticatorData));
+    await assertRpIdHash(authData);
+    if (!authData.userPresent) return error(400, 'User presence was not confirmed.');
+
+    const alg = Number(response.publicKeyAlgorithm);
+    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('spki', base64UrlToBytes(response.publicKey), importParams(alg), true, ['verify']);
+    const publicKeyJwk = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('jwk', key);
+
+    const users = getUsers();
+    const user = users[record.userId];
+    if (!user) return error(400, 'Account not found for this registration.');
+    if (record.flow === 'register') {
+      const session = getSession();
+      if (!session || session.userId !== user.id) return error(401, 'Sign in to continue.', { code: 'unauthenticated' });
+    }
+
+    const credentials = getCredentials();
+    if (credentials[body.id]) return error(409, 'This passkey is already registered.');
+
+    const provider = await providerForAaguid(authData.aaguid);
+    const cred = {
+      id: body.id,
+      passkeyUserId: user.id,
+      credentialPublicKey: response.publicKey,
+      publicKeyJwk,
+      alg,
+      credentialType: 'public-key',
+      credentialDeviceType: authData.backupEligible ? 'multiDevice' : 'singleDevice',
+      credentialBackedUp: authData.backedUp,
+      aaguid: authData.aaguid,
+      providerIcon: provider.providerIcon,
+      providerName: provider.name,
+      name: provider.name,
+      transports: Array.isArray(response.transports) ? response.transports : [],
+      registeredAt: Date.now(),
+      lastUsedAt: undefined,
+      counter: authData.counter,
+    };
+    credentials[cred.id] = cred;
+    saveCredentials(credentials);
+
+    if (record.flow === 'signup') {
+      user.active = true;
+      saveUsers(users);
+      const now = Date.now();
+      saveSession({ userId: user.id, signedInAt: now, reauthAt: now });
+    }
+    return json(201, { user: publicUser(user), credential: publicCredential(cred) });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('[demo-backend] registration verification failed:', err);
+    return error(400, 'The passkey could not be verified.');
+  }
+}
+
+async function handleSigninOptions() {
+  return json(200, {
+    challenge: issueChallenge('signin', { userVerification: 'preferred' }),
+    rpId: RP_ID,
+    allowCredentials: [],
+    userVerification: 'preferred',
+    timeout: 120000,
+  });
+}
+
+async function handleReauthOptions() {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  const creds = credentialsForUser(auth.user.id);
+  return json(200, {
+    challenge: issueChallenge('reauth', { userId: auth.user.id, userVerification: 'preferred' }),
+    rpId: RP_ID,
+    allowCredentials: creds.map((c) => ({ type: 'public-key', id: c.id, transports: c.transports })),
+    userVerification: 'preferred',
+    timeout: 120000,
+  });
+}
+
+async function verifyAssertion(body, flow) {
+  const response = body?.response ?? {};
+  const clientData = parseClientData(response.clientDataJSON, 'webauthn.get');
+  const record = consumeChallenge(clientData.challenge, flow);
+  if (!record) return { response: error(400, 'Sign-in challenge expired. Please try again.') };
+
+  const credentials = getCredentials();
+  const cred = credentials[body?.id];
+  if (!cred) return { response: error(404, 'This passkey is not registered with The Daily Grind.', { code: 'unknown_credential' }) };
+
+  const authDataBytes = base64UrlToBytes(response.authenticatorData);
+  const authData = parseAuthenticatorData(authDataBytes);
+  await assertRpIdHash(authData);
+  if (!authData.userPresent) return { response: error(400, 'User presence was not confirmed.') };
+  if (record.userVerification === 'required' && !authData.userVerified) {
+    return { response: error(400, 'User verification is required.') };
+  }
+  if (response.userHandle && response.userHandle !== cred.passkeyUserId) {
+    return { response: error(400, 'Passkey does not match the account.') };
+  }
+  const valid = await verifyAssertionSignature(cred, authDataBytes, response.clientDataJSON, response.signature);
+  if (!valid) return { response: error(400, 'Invalid passkey signature.') };
+  if ((authData.counter > 0 || cred.counter > 0) && authData.counter <= cred.counter) {
+    return { response: error(400, 'Passkey signature counter did not advance.') };
+  }
+  cred.counter = authData.counter;
+  cred.lastUsedAt = Date.now();
+  credentials[cred.id] = cred;
+  saveCredentials(credentials);
+  return { cred, record };
+}
+
+async function handleSigninVerify(body) {
+  try {
+    const result = await verifyAssertion(body, 'signin');
+    if (result.response) return result.response;
+    const user = getUsers()[result.cred.passkeyUserId];
+    if (!user || !user.active) return error(404, 'The account for this passkey no longer exists.', { code: 'unknown_credential' });
+    const now = Date.now();
+    saveSession({ userId: user.id, signedInAt: now, reauthAt: now });
+    return json(200, { user: publicUser(user), signedInAt: now, reauthAt: now });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('[demo-backend] sign-in verification failed:', err);
+    return error(400, 'The passkey could not be verified.');
+  }
+}
+
+async function handleReauthVerify(body) {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  try {
+    const result = await verifyAssertion(body, 'reauth');
+    if (result.response) return result.response;
+    // A valid passkey that belongs to a different account must never satisfy reauth.
+    if (result.cred.passkeyUserId !== auth.user.id) return error(403, 'That passkey belongs to a different account.');
+    const now = Date.now();
+    saveSession({ ...auth.session, reauthAt: now });
+    return json(200, { verified: true, reauthAt: now });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('[demo-backend] reauthentication failed:', err);
+    return error(400, 'The passkey could not be verified.');
+  }
+}
+
+async function handleListCredentials() {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  return json(200, credentialsForUser(auth.user.id).map(publicCredential));
+}
+
+async function handleRenameCredential(id, body) {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim().slice(0, 64);
+  if (!name) return error(400, 'Name is required.');
+  const credentials = getCredentials();
+  const cred = credentials[id];
+  if (!cred || cred.passkeyUserId !== auth.user.id) return error(404, 'Credential not found.');
+  cred.name = name;
+  saveCredentials(credentials);
+  return json(200, publicCredential(cred));
+}
+
+async function handleDeleteCredential(id) {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  const stale = requireFreshReauth(auth.session);
+  if (stale) return stale;
+  const credentials = getCredentials();
+  const cred = credentials[id];
+  if (!cred || cred.passkeyUserId !== auth.user.id) return error(404, 'Credential not found.');
+  if (credentialsForUser(auth.user.id).length <= 1) {
+    return error(409, 'Add another passkey before removing your only one.', { code: 'last_credential' });
+  }
+  delete credentials[id];
+  saveCredentials(credentials);
+  return json(200, { success: true });
+}
+
+async function handleUpdateUser(body) {
+  const auth = requireSession();
+  if (auth.response) return auth.response;
+  const stale = requireFreshReauth(auth.session);
+  if (stale) return stale;
+  const name = String(body?.name ?? '').trim();
+  const displayName = String(body?.displayName ?? '').trim();
+  if (!name || !displayName) return error(400, 'Name and email are required.');
+  const other = findActiveUserByEmail(name);
+  if (other && other.id !== auth.user.id) return error(409, 'That email is already in use.', { code: 'exists' });
+  const users = getUsers();
+  users[auth.user.id] = { ...users[auth.user.id], name, displayName };
+  saveUsers(users);
+  return json(200, publicUser(users[auth.user.id]));
+}
+
+async function handleLogout() {
+  saveSession(null);
+  return json(200, { success: true });
+}
+
+/* ---------- router ---------- */
+
+/**
+ * Dispatch a request the way an HTTP server would.
+ * @param {string} method
+ * @param {string} path e.g. "/api/signin/options"
+ * @param {unknown} [body]
+ * @returns {Promise<Response>}
+ */
+export async function handle(method, path, body) {
+  const route = `${method.toUpperCase()} ${path.replace(/^\/api/, '')}`;
+  const credentialMatch = route.match(/^(PUT|DELETE) \/credential\/(.+)$/);
+  if (credentialMatch) {
+    const id = decodeURIComponent(credentialMatch[2]);
+    return credentialMatch[1] === 'PUT' ? handleRenameCredential(id, body) : handleDeleteCredential(id);
+  }
+  switch (route) {
+    case 'GET /session': return handleSession();
+    case 'POST /signup/options': return handleSignupOptions(body);
+    case 'POST /register/options': return handleRegisterOptions(body);
+    case 'POST /register/verify': return handleRegisterVerify(body);
+    case 'POST /signin/options': return handleSigninOptions();
+    case 'POST /signin/verify': return handleSigninVerify(body);
+    case 'POST /reauth/options': return handleReauthOptions();
+    case 'POST /reauth/verify': return handleReauthVerify(body);
+    case 'GET /credentials': return handleListCredentials();
+    case 'PUT /user': return handleUpdateUser(body);
+    case 'POST /logout': return handleLogout();
+    default: return error(404, `No route for ${route}`);
+  }
+}
