+/**
+ * Client-side passkey (WebAuthn) flows for The Daily Grind.
+ *
+ * Calls the native browser APIs directly:
+ *  - PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities()     feature detection
+ *  - PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON / parseRequestOptionsFromJSON
+ *  - navigator.credentials.create() / get()          (+ conditional mediation)
+ *  - credential.toJSON()                             transport to the server
+ *  - PublicKeyCredential.signal*()                   keep password managers in sync
+ *
+ * Server interaction goes through js/api.js.
+ */
+import { RP_ID } from './config.js';
+import { api, errorFromResponse } from './api.js';
+
+/** Error with a stable `code` the UI can branch on. */
+export class PasskeyError extends Error {
+  constructor(message, code, cause) {
+    super(message, cause ? { cause } : undefined);
+    this.name = 'PasskeyError';
+    this.code = code;
+  }
+}
+
+/* ---------- feature detection ---------- */
+
+let capabilitiesPromise;
+
+export async function getClientCapabilities() {
+  if (!('PublicKeyCredential' in window)) return null;
+  capabilitiesPromise ??= (async () => {
+    try {
+      return (await PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities()) ?? {};
+    } catch {
+      return {};
+    }
+  })();
+  return capabilitiesPromise;
+}
+
+/**
+ * @returns {Promise<{supported: boolean, platformAuthenticator: boolean, conditionalGet: boolean}>}
+ */
+export async function getPasskeySupport() {
+  const caps = await getClientCapabilities();
+  if (!caps) return { supported: false, platformAuthenticator: false, conditionalGet: false };
+  let platformAuthenticator = caps.passkeyPlatformAuthenticator;
+  if (platformAuthenticator === undefined) {
+    // Older capability sets omit this key; fall back to the legacy check.
+    try {
+      platformAuthenticator = await PublicKeyCredential.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable();
+    } catch {
+      platformAuthenticator = false;
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    supported: true,
+    platformAuthenticator: platformAuthenticator === true,
+    conditionalGet: caps.conditionalGet === true,
+  };
+}
+
+/* ---------- Signal API (all feature-detected; IDs are Base64URL strings) ---------- */
+
+export async function signalUnknownCredential(credentialId) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalUnknownCredential) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId: RP_ID, credentialId });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('signalUnknownCredential failed:', err);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function signalAllAcceptedCredentials(userId, credentials) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId,
+      allAcceptedCredentialIds: credentials.map((c) => c.id),
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('signalAllAcceptedCredentials failed:', err);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function signalCurrentUserDetails(userId, name, displayName) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalCurrentUserDetails) return;
+  try {
+    await PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails({ rpId: RP_ID, userId, name, displayName });
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('signalCurrentUserDetails failed:', err);
+  }
+}
+
+/* ---------- shared error mapping ---------- */
+
+function mapWebAuthnError(err, operation) {
+  switch (err?.name) {
+    case 'InvalidStateError':
+      return new PasskeyError('A passkey for this account already exists in this password manager.', 'exists', err);
+    case 'NotAllowedError':
+      return new PasskeyError(
+        operation === 'create' ? 'Passkey creation was cancelled.' : 'Passkey sign-in was cancelled.',
+        'cancelled',
+        err,
+      );
+    case 'AbortError':
+      return new PasskeyError('The passkey request was interrupted.', 'aborted', err);
+    case 'SecurityError':
+      return new PasskeyError(
+        'Passkeys need a secure (HTTPS or localhost) origin that matches the site configuration.',
+        'security',
+        err,
+      );
+    case 'NotSupportedError':
+      return new PasskeyError('This browser does not support passkeys.', 'unsupported', err);
+    default:
+      return new PasskeyError('Something went wrong with your passkey. Please try again.', 'unknown', err);
+  }
+}
+
+async function throwFromResponse(response, fallback) {
+  const { message, code } = await errorFromResponse(response, fallback);
+  throw new PasskeyError(message, code || `http_${response.status}`);
+}
+
+/* ---------- registration ---------- */
+
+/**
+ * Create a passkey, either for a brand new customer (`flow: 'signup'`, pass
+ * `details: {name, email}`) or for the signed-in user from the management
+ * panel (`flow: 'manage'`).
+ * @returns {Promise<{user: object, credential: object}>}
+ */
+export async function registerPasskey({ flow, details } = {}) {
+  // Never run create() while a conditional get() is pending.
+  abortConditionalSignIn();
+
+  const optionsResponse =
+    flow === 'signup' ? await api.signupOptions(details) : await api.registerOptions({ promotion: false });
+  if (!optionsResponse.ok) await throwFromResponse(optionsResponse, 'Could not start passkey setup.');
+
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(await optionsResponse.json());
+
+  let credential;
+  try {
+    credential = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey });
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw mapWebAuthnError(err, 'create');
+  }
+  if (!credential) throw new PasskeyError('No passkey was created.', 'unknown');
+
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  let verifyResponse;
+  try {
+    verifyResponse = await api.registerVerify(encoded);
+  } catch (networkErr) {
+    // The passkey exists in the provider but not on the server: ask the provider to drop it.
+    await signalUnknownCredential(encoded.id);
+    throw new PasskeyError('Could not reach the server to save your passkey.', 'network', networkErr);
+  }
+  if (!verifyResponse.ok) {
+    await signalUnknownCredential(encoded.id);
+    await throwFromResponse(verifyResponse, 'Your passkey could not be saved.');
+  }
+  return verifyResponse.json();
+}
+
+/* ---------- authentication ---------- */
+
+let conditionalAbortController = null;
+let buttonAbortController = null;
+
+export function abortConditionalSignIn() {
+  conditionalAbortController?.abort();
+  conditionalAbortController = null;
+}
+
+async function verifySignIn(credential, { allowUnknownSignal }) {
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  let response;
+  try {
+    response = await api.signinVerify(encoded);
+  } catch (networkErr) {
+    throw new PasskeyError('Could not reach the server to sign you in.', 'network', networkErr);
+  }
+  if (response.ok) return response.json();
+  if (response.status === 404 && allowUnknownSignal) {
+    // Pre-authentication: tell the provider this passkey is no longer valid here.
+    await signalUnknownCredential(encoded.id);
+  }
+  await throwFromResponse(response, 'Sign-in failed.');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Arm browser autofill (conditional UI) so saved passkeys are offered when the
+ * user focuses an input annotated with autocomplete="... webauthn".
+ * Resolves to the signed-in session when the user picks a passkey, `null`
+ * when unsupported / aborted / cancelled. Server failures reject.
+ */
+export async function startConditionalSignIn() {
+  const caps = await getClientCapabilities();
+  if (caps?.conditionalGet !== true) return null;
+
+  abortConditionalSignIn();
+  const controller = new AbortController();
+  conditionalAbortController = controller;
+
+  const optionsResponse = await api.signinOptions();
+  if (!optionsResponse.ok || controller.signal.aborted) return null;
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(await optionsResponse.json());
+
+  let credential;
+  try {
+    credential = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey, signal: controller.signal, mediation: 'conditional' });
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (['NotAllowedError', 'AbortError'].includes(err?.name)) return null;
+    console.error('Unexpected conditional get error:', err);
+    return null;
+  } finally {
+    if (conditionalAbortController === controller) conditionalAbortController = null;
+  }
+  if (!credential) return null;
+  return verifySignIn(credential, { allowUnknownSignal: true });
+}
+
+/** Explicit "Sign in with a passkey" button flow (discoverable credentials). */
+export async function signInWithPasskey() {
+  // Abort any pending autofill request to avoid prompt collisions.
+  abortConditionalSignIn();
+  buttonAbortController?.abort();
+  buttonAbortController = new AbortController();
+
+  const optionsResponse = await api.signinOptions();
+  if (!optionsResponse.ok) await throwFromResponse(optionsResponse, 'Could not start sign-in.');
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(await optionsResponse.json());
+
+  let credential;
+  try {
+    credential = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey, signal: buttonAbortController.signal });
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw mapWebAuthnError(err, 'get');
+  }
+  if (!credential) throw new PasskeyError('No passkey was selected.', 'cancelled');
+  return verifySignIn(credential, { allowUnknownSignal: true });
+}
+
+/* ---------- reauthentication (step-up for sensitive actions) ---------- */
+
+let reauthAbortController = null;
+
+/**
+ * Re-verify the signed-in user with one of their own passkeys. The server
+ * restricts `allowCredentials` to that user and checks ownership again on verify.
+ * @returns {Promise<{verified: true, reauthAt: number}>}
+ */
+export async function reauthenticateWithPasskey() {
+  abortConditionalSignIn();
+  reauthAbortController?.abort();
+  reauthAbortController = new AbortController();
+
+  const optionsResponse = await api.reauthOptions();
+  if (!optionsResponse.ok) await throwFromResponse(optionsResponse, 'Could not start verification.');
+  const optionsJSON = await optionsResponse.json();
+  if (!optionsJSON.allowCredentials?.length) {
+    throw new PasskeyError('No passkeys are registered for this account.', 'no_credentials');
+  }
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(optionsJSON);
+
+  let credential;
+  try {
+    credential = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey, signal: reauthAbortController.signal });
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw mapWebAuthnError(err, 'get');
+  }
+  if (!credential) throw new PasskeyError('No passkey was selected.', 'cancelled');
+
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  let response;
+  try {
+    response = await api.reauthVerify(encoded);
+  } catch (networkErr) {
+    throw new PasskeyError('Could not reach the server to verify your passkey.', 'network', networkErr);
+  }
+  if (response.ok) return response.json();
+  if (response.status === 404) await signalUnknownCredential(encoded.id);
+  await throwFromResponse(response, 'Verification failed.');
+}

+/** Small shared helpers (Base64URL + typed-array conversions). */
+
+export function bufferToBase64Url(buffer) {
+  const bytes = buffer instanceof Uint8Array ? buffer : new Uint8Array(buffer);
+  let binary = '';
+  for (const b of bytes) binary += String.fromCharCode(b);
+  return btoa(binary).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
+}
+
+export function base64UrlToBytes(value) {
+  const base64 = value.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
+  const padded = base64 + '==='.slice((base64.length + 3) % 4);
+  const binary = atob(padded);
+  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
+  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
+  return bytes;
+}
+
+export function randomBase64Url(byteLength = 32) {
+  return bufferToBase64Url(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(byteLength)));
+}
+
+export function utf8Decode(bytes) {
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
+}
+
+export function utf8Encode(text) {
+  return new TextEncoder().encode(text);
+}
+
+export function concatBytes(...parts) {
+  const total = parts.reduce((n, p) => n + p.byteLength, 0);
+  const out = new Uint8Array(total);
+  let offset = 0;
+  for (const p of parts) {
+    out.set(p instanceof Uint8Array ? p : new Uint8Array(p), offset);
+    offset += p.byteLength;
+  }
+  return out;
+}
+
+export function bytesEqual(a, b) {
+  if (a.byteLength !== b.byteLength) return false;
+  for (let i = 0; i < a.byteLength; i++) if (a[i] !== b[i]) return false;
+  return true;
+}
+
+/** Format 16 bytes as a canonical lowercase UUID string. */
+export function bytesToUuid(bytes) {
+  const hex = Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
+  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
+}

+# Daily Grind – Web Performance Audit (2026-10-28)
+
+Scope: `index.html`, the only page in the repo, served by `statikk` (a static
+file server built on `serve-static` + `compression`). Audit was done by static
+analysis of the markup and by measuring the network payloads with `curl`; no
+browser or dev server was run.
+
+## Baseline findings
+
+| Area | Finding | Impact |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| LCP | Hero photo loaded as a CSS `background-image` from `images.unsplash.com`. CSS backgrounds are invisible to the preload scanner and only requested after the CSSOM is built and layout decides the element is visible. | Hero (the LCP element) starts loading late. |
+| LCP | Third-party origin with no `preconnect`. | Extra DNS + TCP + TLS round-trips before the first image byte. |
+| LCP / bytes | One fixed 1350 px wide 3:2 JPEG for every device (158 KB as JPEG; 63 KB when the browser negotiates AVIF). | Phones download desktop-sized pixels, then `cover` crops most of them away. |
+| CLS | Fixed `height: 60vh` and system fonts, so no shift on load. `vh` on mobile does resize when the URL bar collapses. | Low, but a small shift on scroll in mobile Safari/Chrome. |
+| INP | No JavaScript at all; only two 0.3 s colour transitions. | Nothing to fix; no long tasks possible. |
+| Render blocking | CSS is inline, no external fonts or scripts. | Already good. |
+| Delivery | `statikk` gzips responses and sends `ETag`/`Last-Modified`, but exposes no option for `Cache-Control: immutable`. | Repeat visits revalidate every asset. |
+
+## Changes made
+
+1. **Hero image converted to a self-hosted `<picture>` element** with
+   `fetchpriority="high"` and `decoding="async"`. The preload scanner now
+   issues the request while parsing the `<head>`, and it is same-origin, so
+   the connection is already warm.
+2. **Art-directed, responsive sources.** Portrait crops (3:4) at 480/768/1080 px
+   for phones, 16:9 crops at 1200/1600/1920 px for tablets and desktops, each
+   in AVIF and WebP with a JPEG fallback. Crops match what `object-fit: cover`
+   displays, so almost no downloaded pixels are discarded. Quality 60 is used
+   because the photo sits under a 50 % black overlay that masks artefacts.
+3. **Placeholder background colour** on the hero so the white headline is
+   legible before the photo paints and there is no white flash.
+4. **`min-height: 60svh`** (with `60vh` fallback) so the hero does not resize
+   when mobile browser chrome collapses.
+5. **`prefers-reduced-motion`** rule disables the hover transitions for users
+   who request it.
+
+## Hero bytes, before vs. after
+
+| Device | Before | After |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Phone, 390 px @3x, AVIF | 63 KB (1350×900, about half of it cropped away) | 77 KB (1080×1440, ~100 % displayed) |
+| Phone, 360 px @2x, AVIF | 63 KB | 49 KB |
+| Phone, JPEG-only fallback | 158 KB | 94 KB |
+| Laptop 1440 px @2x, AVIF | 63 KB (1350 px wide, upscaled 2.1×) | 83 KB (1920 px wide) |
+| Desktop 1920 px @1x, WebP (no AVIF support) | 145 KB (1350 px, upscaled 1.4×) | 172 KB (1920 px, crisp) |
+
+Byte counts are similar or slightly higher on some devices because the old
+image was undersized for them; the win is in *when* the request starts
+(discovered from HTML, same origin, high priority) and in sharper output.
+
+## Recommended follow-ups (outside this repo)
+
+* **Caching.** When deploying behind a real CDN or web server, serve
+  `images/` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` and
+  the HTML with a short max-age. Rename image files with a content hash if
+  they ever change.
+* **Brotli.** `compression` only emits gzip; enable Brotli at the edge for a
+  further ~15 % on the HTML.
+* **Navigation speed.** Once `/menu`, `/locations` etc. exist, add a
+  Speculation Rules `prefetch` list for the nav links so follow-on page
+  loads are near-instant.
